checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'content-distribution'.

checks.description: Plan repurposes one article into email, organic-social, and other formats.
checks.rule: Output derivatives[] include email and organic-social formats derived from one source article.

checks.description: Each derivative is routed to its producing owner, not authored here.
checks.rule: Body routes email to lifecycle-architect and copywriters and social to organic-social, and states this skill does not write final copy.

checks.description: Every derivative carries the source article angle and a CTA.
checks.rule: Each derivative includes angle_carried and cta tied to the source article.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.

checks.description: Western numerals only and no tatweel.
checks.rule: No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) and no tatweel (U+0640) appear.

checks.description: No invented offer, price, Skill Path title, or instructor name in any derivative.
checks.rule: Derivatives reference only offers and titles traceable to the brief; absent ones trigger stop-and-ask, never accreditation claims.

checks.description: No distribution tool is adopted without approval.
checks.rule: Body states a distribution tool is not adopted or wired without approval, per CLAUDE.md principle 3.
